  header, `RiverTrace.scale`'s comment, the private `lineEnd` (the loop's three end cases, moved unchanged) and the
  block after the loop. Read whole: the block runs only when the last try failed; it reads no stream (no draw, so a
  later attempt and a tributary read what they read before); it returns the last try — degraded, as before — when the
  line is stuck, when its course touches itself at the class's clearance, or when `planCarve` reports a cut past
